data.summary: Guard drift: the per-family adapter docs page is prose-only, so ports landed without docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md. ddflow/adapters/ports.py and tests/test_ports_contract.py both document that a family is its <family>.py port + fakes/<family>.py + tests/test_adapter_<family>.py + docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md, but no machine check enforces the .md page. ADP-config-store merged (8194712e6790) with ddflow/adapters/config_store.py + fakes/config_store.py + tests/test_adapter_config_store.py and NO docs/ddflow/adapters/config_store.md; indexdb (IndexStore) and managed_files (ManagedFile) ships the same gap. Add a test_every_port_family_has_a_docs_page guard in tests/test_ports_contract.py and write the three missing pages.
data.title: Adapter docs-page guard drift: config_store/indexdb/managed_files have no docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md and no machine check enforces one

data.body:
Fixes bug B0971e4d5a0: Guard drift: the per-family adapter docs page is prose-only, so ports landed without docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md. ddflow/adapters/ports.py and tests/test_ports_contract.py both document that a family is its <family>.py port + fakes/<family>.py + tests/test_adapter_<family>.py + docs/ddflow/adapters/<family>.md, but no machine check enforces the .md page. ADP-config-store merged (8194712e6790) with ddflow/adapters/config_store.py + fakes/config_store.py + tests/test_adapter_config_store.py and NO docs/ddflow/adapters/config_store.md; indexdb (IndexStore) and managed_files (ManagedFile) ships the same gap. Add a test_every_port_family_has_a_docs_page guard in tests/test_ports_contract.py and write the three missing pages.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B0971e4d5a0 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B0971e4d5a0 --regression-test <test>` first).
